nodes.description: address public owner; protocol fee recipient set to msg.sender
address public king; holder of the spirit throne, receives transfer cut
uint public kingSpirit; highest spirit score seen
address public queen; holder of the prestige throne, receives transfer cut
uint public queenPrestige; highest prestige score seen
uint public totalCities; incremented on first user initiation
uint public buildings_total; number of registered building templates
uint public sell_id; monotonically increasing marketplace listing id
mapping(address=>mapping(uint=>uint)) marketplacePrices; listing price per seller/item
mapping(address=>mapping(uint=>uint)) marketplaceID; listing id per seller/item
mapping(address=>City) kingdoms; per-user city resources, factors and map
mapping(uint=>Building) buildings; building template table (price, resource, bonus)
constructor: initialises owner, king, queen, counters
owner-only registration of a building template in buildings mapping
emits Resources event with the caller's five basic resources
promotes caller to king/queen when spirit/prestige exceeds stored values
one-time initialisation of a new player's city with 5 of each resource
places a building on the caller's map, charging resources and applying bonus
payable map expansion along X, forwards msg.value to owner
payable map expansion along Y, forwards msg.value to owner
time-gated claim of basic resources based on resourceFactors
time-gated claim of special items; award branch driven by timestamp-derived value
creates a marketplace listing for one resource item at a price
payable purchase from a listing, crediting buyer and splitting fees to owner/king/queen/seller
payable purchase of special buildings 97/98/99 granting spirit/prestige
msg.sender; external caller used for kingdom lookup, ownership checks and transfers
block.timestamp (now); used for cooldown asserts and pseudo-random award selection
tx.origin; not referenced in this contract, retained as declared untrusted input class
owner.transfer(...) external value transfer to the owner address
king.transfer(cut) external value transfer to the current king
queen.transfer(cut) external value transfer to the current queen
seller.transfer(msg.value-(cut*5)) external value transfer to an arbitrary seller
unchecked uint add/sub on resources, resourceFactors, totalCities, buildings_total and sell_id
select = ((now-(item+shopIndex))%13); block variables used as pseudo-randomness for item awards
assert(now >= lastClaim + cooldown); timestamp-dependent cooldown gate that reverts on early claim
initBuilding parameter r0: first cost resource index
initBuilding parameter r1: second cost resource index
initBuilding parameter p0: price of resource0
initBuilding parameter p1: price of resource1
initBuilding parameter m: resourceIndex awarded
initBuilding parameter a: resourceAmount awarded
buildAt parameter xpos: target map x coordinate
buildAt parameter ypos: target map y coordinate
buildAt parameter building: index into the buildings template table
claimSpecialResource parameter shopIndex: 6..9 selecting the special shop
claimSpecialResource loop counter item
claimSpecialResource local select: timestamp-derived award bucket
claimSpecialResource local finalI: resource slot awarded to the player
sellItem parameter item: resource index being listed
sellItem parameter price: listing price in wei
buyItem parameter seller: listing owner whose item is bought
buyItem parameter item: resource index being purchased
buyItem local cut: msg.value/100 fee unit split between owner, king, queen and seller
buySpecialBuilding parameter xpos: target map x coordinate
buySpecialBuilding parameter ypos: target map y coordinate
buySpecialBuilding parameter building: must be 97, 98 or 99 with matching msg.value

edges.reason: constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
constructor assigns king = msg.sender
constructor assigns queen = msg.sender
initBuilding gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
r0 written into buildings template resource0
r1 written into buildings template resource1
p0 written into buildings template price0
p1 written into buildings template price1
m written into buildings template resourceIndex
a written into buildings template resourceAmount
buildings[buildings_total] = Building(r0,r1,p0,p1,m,a)
buildings_total += 1 unchecked counter increment
logResources reads kingdoms[msg.sender] resources
newLeader reads kingdoms[msg.sender].resourceFactors
newLeader can promote msg.sender to king when spirit exceeds kingSpirit
newLeader can promote msg.sender to queen when prestige exceeds queenPrestige
kingSpirit updated from caller resourceFactors[10]
queenPrestige updated from caller resourceFactors[11]
initiateUser initialises kingdoms[msg.sender] once
initiateUser sets initiatet flag, resources, mapX/mapY
totalCities += 1 unchecked counter increment
initiateUser calls logResources after initialisation
buildAt operates on kingdoms[msg.sender] map and resources
xpos used as map X index and bounds check
ypos used as map Y index and bounds check
building indexes buildings[] for price, resourceIndex, resourceAmount
buildAt writes map[xpos][ypos] and resourceFactors bonus into kingdoms[msg.sender]
buildAt subtracts price0/price1 from resources without underflow guard beyond require
buildAt calls newLeader, allowing throne takeover as a side effect
buildAt calls logResources at the end
expandX reads kingdoms[msg.sender].mapY for the price assertion
expandX forwards msg.value to owner
expandY reads kingdoms[msg.sender].mapX for the price assertion
expandY forwards msg.value to owner
claimBasicResources credits kingdoms[msg.sender].resources
claimBasicResources cooldown depends on now (timestamp dependency)
assert(now >= lastClaimResources + 1 hours) timestamp gate
claimBasicResources adds resourceFactors to resources (unchecked addition)
claimBasicResources calls logResources
claimSpecialResource credits kingdoms[msg.sender].resources and lastClaimItems
shopIndex selects the special resource shop and cooldown slot
loop counter item bounds the award repetition per factor
claimSpecialResource cooldown and award output derive from now (timestamp dependency)
now feeds the pseudo-random award selection
claimSpecialResource computes select = (now-(item+shopIndex))%13 as randomness source
finalI derived from select indexes resources[] to award items
claimSpecialResource increments resources[finalI] and stores lastClaimItems[shopIndex]
assert(now >= lastClaimItems[shopIndex] + 3 hours) timestamp gate
sellItem lists kingdoms[msg.sender].resources[item]
item index validated and used as marketplace key
price stored in marketplacePrices[seller][item]
sellItem writes marketplacePrices[msg.sender][item] = price
sellItem writes marketplaceID[msg.sender][item] = sell_id
sell_id += 1 unchecked counter increment
sellItem calls logResources
buyItem credits kingdoms[msg.sender].resources and pays fees
seller address keys marketplacePrices/marketplaceID lookups
item index used for credit and listing lookup
cut = msg.value/100 determines the seller payout
buyItem reads price and clears marketplacePrices[seller][item] after the transfers
buyItem reads marketplaceID[seller][item] for the BuyItem event
buyItem increments kingdoms[msg.sender].resources[item]
buyItem sends cut*3 to owner
buyItem performs external king.transfer(cut) before marketplacePrices is cleared
buyItem performs external queen.transfer(cut) on thrones controlled by other users
buyItem calls seller.transfer after crediting the buyer and before zeroing the listing
buyItem calls logResources
buySpecialBuilding writes kingdoms[msg.sender] map and resourceFactors
xpos bounds-checked and used as map X index
ypos bounds-checked and used as map Y index
building must be 97/98/99 and selects the spirit or prestige bonus
buySpecialBuilding sets map[xpos][ypos] and increments resourceFactors[10]/[11]
resourceFactors[10]/[11] += 8/16 unchecked bonus increments
buySpecialBuilding forwards msg.value to owner
buySpecialBuilding calls newLeader, granting throne takeover on paid prestige/spirit
constructor establishes owner privileges from the deploying caller

normalization_plan.reason: r0 is only used to initialise the buildings entry keyed by buildings_total in initBuilding
r1 is only used to initialise the buildings entry resource1 field
p0 is only used to initialise the buildings entry price0 field
p1 is only used to initialise the buildings entry price1 field
m is only used to initialise the buildings entry resourceIndex field
a is only used to initialise the buildings entry resourceAmount field
xpos exists solely as the buildAt map X argument and bounds check
ypos exists solely as the buildAt map Y argument and bounds check
building exists solely to index buildings[] inside buildAt
shopIndex exists solely to gate and index claimSpecialResource state
loop counter item exists solely inside claimSpecialResource
select is the value produced by the timestamp pseudo-random expression and feeds the unsafe award branch
finalI is the award slot written to kingdoms resources inside claimSpecialResource
item exists solely as the sellItem resource index and validation bound
price exists solely as the sellItem marketplace listing value
seller exists solely as the buyItem marketplace lookup and transfer target
item exists solely as the buyItem credit and listing index
cut is derived from msg.value and directly determines the owner/king/queen/seller transfer amounts
xpos exists solely as the buySpecialBuilding map X argument and bounds check
ypos exists solely as the buySpecialBuilding map Y argument and bounds check
building exists solely to select the 97/98/99 payment branch and bonus applied in buySpecialBuilding
